import json, csv, os

OUT_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results/figure_data"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
RESULTS = "/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results"

# ============================================================
# 1. fig_2x2_matrix.csv
# ============================================================
with open(f"{RESULTS}/rsa/perlayer_rsa_all_conditions.json") as f:
    perlayer_all = json.load(f)

peaks = perlayer_all["peaks"]
rows = [
    ["trained_with_inst", "trained", "with_inst", peaks["trained_with_inst"]["rsa"], peaks["trained_with_inst"]["layer"]],
    ["trained_no_inst", "trained", "no_inst", peaks["trained_no_inst"]["rsa"], peaks["trained_no_inst"]["layer"]],
    ["untrained_with_inst", "untrained", "with_inst", peaks["untrained_with_inst"]["rsa"], peaks["untrained_with_inst"]["layer"]],
    ["untrained_no_inst", "untrained", "no_inst", peaks["untrained_no_inst"]["rsa"], peaks["untrained_no_inst"]["layer"]],
    ["dino", "dino", "na", perlayer_all["reference_lines"]["dino"], 0],
]
with open(f"{OUT_DIR}/fig_2x2_matrix.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["condition", "training", "instruction", "peak_rsa", "peak_layer"])
    w.writerows(rows)
print("1. fig_2x2_matrix.csv DONE")

# ============================================================
# 2. fig_siglip_vs_vla_vs_dino.csv
# ============================================================
with open(f"{RESULTS}/rsa/rsa_siglip_only.json") as f:
    siglip = json.load(f)
with open(f"{RESULTS}/rsa/rsa_results_no_inst.json") as f:
    no_inst = json.load(f)

vla_peaks = [peaks["trained_with_inst"]["rsa"], peaks["trained_no_inst"]["rsa"],
             peaks["untrained_with_inst"]["rsa"], peaks["untrained_no_inst"]["rsa"]]
vla_mean = sum(vla_peaks) / len(vla_peaks)

# Bootstrap CIs: use the no_inst file which has bootstrap data
# For VLA we average the trained and untrained bootstrap CIs
trained_ci = no_inst["bootstrap_ci"]["trained_ci95"]
untrained_ci = no_inst["bootstrap_ci"]["untrained_ci95"]
vla_ci_lower = (trained_ci[0] + untrained_ci[0]) / 2
vla_ci_upper = (trained_ci[1] + untrained_ci[1]) / 2

dino_ci = no_inst["bootstrap_ci"]["dino_ci95"]

rows = [
    ["SigLIP_Projector", siglip["siglip_only_peak_rsa"], siglip["ci95"][0], siglip["ci95"][1]],
    ["Full_VLA_mean", round(vla_mean, 4),
     round(vla_ci_lower, 4), round(vla_ci_upper, 4)],
    ["DINO", perlayer_all["reference_lines"]["dino"],
     round(dino_ci[0], 4), round(dino_ci[1], 4)],
]
with open(f"{OUT_DIR}/fig_siglip_vs_vla_vs_dino.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["model", "rsa", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"])
    w.writerows(rows)
print("2. fig_siglip_vs_vla_vs_dino.csv DONE")

# ============================================================
# 3. fig_perlayer_rsa.csv
# ============================================================
conditions = perlayer_all["conditions"]
dino_val = perlayer_all["reference_lines"]["dino"]
siglip_val = perlayer_all["reference_lines"]["siglip_projector"]

with open(f"{OUT_DIR}/fig_perlayer_rsa.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["layer", "trained_with_inst", "untrained_with_inst",
                "trained_no_inst", "untrained_no_inst", "dino", "siglip_projector"])
    for i in range(33):
        key = f"layer_{i}"
        w.writerow([
            i,
            conditions["trained_with_inst"][key],
            conditions["untrained_with_inst"][key],
            conditions["trained_no_inst"][key],
            conditions["untrained_no_inst"][key],
            dino_val,
            siglip_val
        ])
print("3. fig_perlayer_rsa.csv DONE")

# ============================================================
# 4. fig_probing_summary.csv
# ============================================================
def load_summary(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)

# Temporal distance
td_trained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/trained/temporal_distance/summary.json")
td_untrained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/untrained/temporal_distance/summary.json")
td_dino = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/dinov2/temporal_distance/summary.json")

# Action prediction
ap_trained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/trained/action_prediction/summary.json")
ap_untrained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/untrained/action_prediction/summary.json")
ap_dino = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/dinov2/action_prediction/summary.json")

# Action delta
ad_trained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/trained/action_delta/summary.json")
ad_untrained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/untrained/action_delta/summary.json")
ad_dino = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/dinov2/action_delta/summary.json")

# Goal classification MLP
gc_trained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/trained_libero_goal/goal_classification/summary.json")
gc_untrained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/untrained_libero_goal/goal_classification/summary.json")
gc_dino = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/dinov2_libero_goal/goal_classification/summary.json")

# Goal classification linear (PCA+linear from pca1024_linear_perlayer.json)
gc_linear_trained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/trained_libero_goal_linear/goal_classification/summary.json")
gc_linear_untrained = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/untrained_libero_goal_linear/goal_classification/summary.json")
gc_linear_dino = load_summary(f"{RESULTS}/dinov2_libero_goal_linear/goal_classification/summary.json")

# RSA (use peaks from perlayer_all)
rsa_trained = peaks["trained_with_inst"]["rsa"]
rsa_untrained = peaks["untrained_with_inst"]["rsa"]
rsa_dino = perlayer_all["reference_lines"]["dino"]

probing_rows = [
    ["temporal_distance", "LIBERO-10", "spearman_rho",
     td_trained["best_rho"], td_untrained["best_rho"], td_dino["best_rho"],
     round(td_trained["best_rho"] - td_untrained["best_rho"], 4),
     td_trained["best_layer"], td_untrained["best_layer"], td_dino["best_layer"]],
    ["action_prediction", "LIBERO-10", "R2",
     ap_trained["best_r2"], ap_untrained["best_r2"], ap_dino["best_r2"],
     round(ap_trained["best_r2"] - ap_untrained["best_r2"], 4),
     ap_trained["best_layer"], ap_untrained["best_layer"], ap_dino["best_layer"]],
    ["action_delta", "LIBERO-10", "R2",
     ad_trained["best_r2"], ad_untrained["best_r2"], ad_dino["best_r2"],
     round(ad_trained["best_r2"] - ad_untrained["best_r2"], 4),
     ad_trained["best_layer"], ad_untrained["best_layer"], ad_dino["best_layer"]],
    ["goal_classification_mlp", "LIBERO-Goal", "accuracy",
     gc_trained["best_accuracy"], gc_untrained["best_accuracy"], gc_dino["best_accuracy"],
     round(gc_trained["best_accuracy"] - gc_untrained["best_accuracy"], 4),
     gc_trained["best_layer"], gc_untrained["best_layer"], gc_dino["best_layer"]],
    ["goal_classification_linear", "LIBERO-Goal", "accuracy",
     gc_linear_trained["best_accuracy"], gc_linear_untrained["best_accuracy"], gc_linear_dino["best_accuracy"],
     round(gc_linear_trained["best_accuracy"] - gc_linear_untrained["best_accuracy"], 4),
     gc_linear_trained["best_layer"], gc_linear_untrained["best_layer"], gc_linear_dino["best_layer"]],
    ["rsa", "LIBERO-Goal", "spearman_rho",
     rsa_trained, rsa_untrained, rsa_dino,
     round(rsa_trained - rsa_untrained, 4),
     peaks["trained_with_inst"]["layer"], peaks["untrained_with_inst"]["layer"], 0],
]

with open(f"{OUT_DIR}/fig_probing_summary.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["method", "benchmark", "metric", "trained", "untrained", "dino",
                "delta_trained_untrained", "best_layer_trained", "best_layer_untrained", "best_layer_dino"])
    w.writerows(probing_rows)
print("4. fig_probing_summary.csv DONE")

# ============================================================
# 5. fig_output_head.json
# ============================================================
with open(f"{RESULTS}/output_head_analysis.json") as f:
    oha = json.load(f)

gs = oha["group_summary"]
llm_layers = oha["llm_per_layer_summary"]

components = ["vision", "projector", "embedding"]
rel_change = [
    gs["vision"]["relative_change_mean"],
    gs["projector"]["relative_change_mean"],
    gs["embedding"]["relative_change_mean"]
]
cos_sim = [
    gs["vision"]["cosine_sim_mean"],
    gs["projector"]["cosine_sim_mean"],
    gs["embedding"]["cosine_sim_mean"]
]

for i in range(32):
    layer_data = llm_layers[str(i)]
    components.append(f"llm_L{i}")
    rel_change.append(layer_data["relative_change_mean"])
    cos_sim.append(layer_data["cosine_sim_mean"])

# Add llm_final_norm
components.append("llm_final_norm")
rel_change.append(gs["llm_final_norm"]["relative_change_mean"])
cos_sim.append(gs["llm_final_norm"]["cosine_sim_mean"])

# Add lm_head
components.append("lm_head")
rel_change.append(gs["head"]["relative_change_mean"])
cos_sim.append(gs["head"]["cosine_sim_mean"])

output_head = {
    "components": components,
    "rel_change": [round(v, 6) for v in rel_change],
    "cos_sim": [round(v, 6) for v in cos_sim]
}

with open(f"{OUT_DIR}/fig_output_head.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(output_head, f, indent=2)
print("5. fig_output_head.json DONE")

print("\n=== ALL FILES CREATED ===")
